1-1-01-bruschetta.en: Let's share the bruschetta while we wait for our main courses.
1-1-01-bruschetta.zh: 我們等主餐的時候，先一起吃普切塔吧。

1-1-02-paella.en: This paella is full of shrimp, mussels, and saffron rice.
1-1-02-paella.zh: 這道西班牙海鮮燉飯裡有滿滿的蝦、淡菜和番紅花飯。

1-1-03-risotto.en: Keep stirring the risotto, or the rice will stick to the pan.
1-1-03-risotto.zh: 燉飯要一直攪拌，不然米會黏鍋。

1-1-04-grilled-vegetables.en: The grilled vegetables come with a little olive oil and sea salt.
1-1-04-grilled-vegetables.zh: 烤時蔬會淋一點橄欖油、撒點海鹽。

1-1-05-roasted-salmon-steak.en: My roasted salmon steak was crispy outside and soft inside.
1-1-05-roasted-salmon-steak.zh: 我的烤鮭魚排外酥內嫩。

1-1-06-duck-confit.en: The duck confit is cooked slowly in its own fat for hours.
1-1-06-duck-confit.zh: 油封鴨是用鴨本身的油慢慢煮好幾個小時。

1-1-07-focaccia.en: This warm focaccia smells like rosemary and olive oil.
1-1-07-focaccia.zh: 這塊溫熱的佛卡夏聞起來有迷迭香和橄欖油的香味。

1-1-08-calamari.en: Could we get the fried calamari with extra lemon, please?
1-1-08-calamari.zh: 炸魷魚圈可以多給一點檸檬嗎？

1-1-09-lamb-shank.en: The lamb shank is so tender that it falls off the bone.
1-1-09-lamb-shank.zh: 這份燉羊膝軟嫩到肉一碰就從骨頭上掉下來。

1-1-10-prosciutto-and-melon.en: Prosciutto and melon is a perfect starter on a hot summer day.
1-1-10-prosciutto-and-melon.zh: 炎熱的夏天，蜜瓜火腿是最完美的前菜。

1-1-11-rack-of-lamb.en: We ordered a rack of lamb to share for our anniversary.
1-1-11-rack-of-lamb.zh: 我們點了一份烤羊排，一起慶祝結婚紀念日。

1-1-12-beef-wellington.en: Beef Wellington is a steak wrapped in pastry and baked.
1-1-12-beef-wellington.zh: 威靈頓牛排是用酥皮包住牛排再烤出來的。

1-1-13-t-bone.en: A T-bone has a strip steak on one side and tenderloin on the other.
1-1-13-t-bone.zh: 丁骨牛排的一邊是紐約客，另一邊是菲力。

1-1-14-new-york-strip.en: I'll have the New York strip, medium rare.
1-1-14-new-york-strip.zh: 我要紐約客牛排，三分熟。

1-1-15-filet-mignon.en: The filet mignon is small, but it's the most tender steak.
1-1-15-filet-mignon.zh: 菲力牛排份量雖小，卻是最嫩的牛排。

1-1-16-porterhouse.en: A porterhouse is big enough for two hungry people to share.
1-1-16-porterhouse.zh: 一塊紅屋牛排大到夠兩個餓肚子的人分著吃。

1-1-17-tomahawk-steak.en: Everyone took photos when the tomahawk steak arrived at our table.
1-1-17-tomahawk-steak.zh: 戰斧牛排一上桌，大家都忙著拍照。

1-1-18-rib-eye.en: I love the rib eye because it's juicy and full of flavor.
1-1-18-rib-eye.zh: 我很愛肋眼牛排，因為它多汁又夠味。

1-1-19-tiramisu.en: The tiramisu here has a strong coffee taste.
1-1-19-tiramisu.zh: 這裡的提拉米蘇咖啡味很濃。

1-1-20-souffle.en: Please order the soufflé early, because it takes twenty minutes to bake.
1-1-20-souffle.zh: 舒芙蕾要烤二十分鐘，請提早點。

1-1-21-sundae.en: The kids shared a chocolate sundae with whipped cream and a cherry.
1-1-21-sundae.zh: 孩子們分吃一份加了鮮奶油和櫻桃的巧克力聖代。

1-1-22-brownie.en: Can I get a scoop of ice cream on my brownie?
1-1-22-brownie.zh: 我的布朗尼可以加一球冰淇淋嗎？

1-1-23-cheek.en: Beef cheek becomes soft and rich after cooking in red wine.
1-1-23-cheek.zh: 牛頰肉用紅酒燉過之後會變得又軟又濃郁。

1-1-24-neck.en: The neck is a tough cut, so it's best for soups.
1-1-24-neck.zh: 牛頸肉比較硬，最適合拿來煮湯。

1-1-25-chuck.en: Ground chuck makes really juicy hamburgers.
1-1-25-chuck.zh: 用牛肩胛絞肉做的漢堡排特別多汁。

1-1-26-brisket.en: Texas barbecue places smoke brisket for more than ten hours.
1-1-26-brisket.zh: 德州烤肉店會把前胸肉煙燻超過十個小時。

1-1-27-shank.en: Beef shank is great for braising with soy sauce and star anise.
1-1-27-shank.zh: 牛腱很適合加醬油和八角來滷。

1-1-28-rib.en: The butcher cut the rib into thick steaks for the grill.
1-1-28-rib.zh: 肉販把牛肋排切成厚片，準備拿去烤。

1-1-29-plate.en: Cuts from the plate are often used for fajitas and Korean barbecue.
1-1-29-plate.zh: 牛腹肉常被拿來做墨西哥法士達和韓式烤肉。

1-1-30-short-loin.en: Both T-bone and porterhouse steaks come from the short loin.
1-1-30-short-loin.zh: 丁骨和紅屋牛排都來自前腰脊肉。

1-1-31-flank.en: Slice the flank thinly against the grain so it isn't chewy.
1-1-31-flank.zh: 牛腹脅肉要逆紋切薄，吃起來才不會太韌。

1-1-32-sirloin.en: I'll have the sirloin with mashed potatoes and a side salad.
1-1-32-sirloin.zh: 我要沙朗牛排，配馬鈴薯泥和一份小沙拉。

1-1-33-tenderloin.en: The whole tenderloin is expensive because each cow has so little of it.
1-1-33-tenderloin.zh: 整條菲力很貴，因為每頭牛身上只有一點點。

1-1-34-top-sirloin.en: Top sirloin is a lean steak that doesn't cost too much.
1-1-34-top-sirloin.zh: 上後腰脊肉是一種油脂少、價格也不太貴的牛排。

1-1-35-bottom-sirloin.en: Bottom sirloin is often used for roast beef and tri-tip.
1-1-35-bottom-sirloin.zh: 下後腰脊肉常用來做烤牛肉和三角肉。

1-1-36-rump.en: We roasted a rump for Sunday dinner with the whole family.
1-1-36-rump.zh: 我們烤了一塊牛臀肉，當全家人的週日晚餐。

1-1-37-round.en: The round is very lean, so it's good for beef jerky.
1-1-37-round.zh: 後腿肉很瘦，很適合拿來做牛肉乾。

1-2-01-fish-and-chips.en: In London, we ate fish and chips with salt and vinegar.
1-2-01-fish-and-chips.zh: 在倫敦，我們吃了撒鹽、淋醋的炸魚薯條。

1-2-02-toad-in-the-hole.en: Toad-in-the-hole is just sausages baked in a puffy batter.
1-2-02-toad-in-the-hole.zh: 「蟾蜍在洞」其實就是把香腸放進麵糊裡烤到膨起來。

1-2-03-lancashire-hot-pot.en: Lancashire hot pot is lamb stew topped with sliced potatoes.
1-2-03-lancashire-hot-pot.zh: 蘭開夏燉羊肉就是上面鋪著馬鈴薯片的燉羊肉。

1-2-04-shepherds-pie.en: My mom makes shepherd's pie with lamb and mashed potatoes.
1-2-04-shepherds-pie.zh: 我媽媽做的牧羊人派是用羊肉和馬鈴薯泥。

1-2-05-cornish-pasty.en: A Cornish pasty is easy to eat with your hands.
1-2-05-cornish-pasty.zh: 康沃爾餡餅很方便直接用手拿著吃。

1-2-06-bangers-and-mash.en: The pub's bangers and mash comes with lots of onion gravy.
1-2-06-bangers-and-mash.zh: 這家酒吧的香腸佐薯泥附上滿滿的洋蔥肉汁。

1-2-07-biryani.en: The chicken biryani smells amazing with all those spices.
1-2-07-biryani.zh: 雞肉印度香飯加了那麼多香料，聞起來超香。

1-2-08-tandoori-chicken.en: Tandoori chicken is red because of the spices in the yogurt.
1-2-08-tandoori-chicken.zh: 印度烤雞會紅紅的，是因為優格醃料裡的香料。

1-2-09-pakora.en: We dipped each crispy pakora in mint sauce.
1-2-09-pakora.zh: 我們把每個酥脆的帕可拉都沾了薄荷醬。

1-2-10-masala-dosa.en: A masala dosa is a thin, crispy pancake filled with spicy potatoes.
1-2-10-masala-dosa.zh: 印度瑪撒拉香料捲餅是包著香辣馬鈴薯的酥脆薄餅。

1-2-11-paratha.en: The paratha is flaky and buttery, a bit like Taiwanese scallion pancake.
1-2-11-paratha.zh: 印度抓餅層層酥脆、奶油香濃，有點像台灣的蔥油餅。

1-2-12-naan.en: Can we have one more garlic naan for the curry?
1-2-12-naan.zh: 可以再給我們一片大蒜烤餅配咖哩嗎？

1-2-13-roti.en: Tear off a piece of roti and use it to scoop up the curry.
1-2-13-roti.zh: 撕一塊印度薄餅，用它把咖哩舀起來吃。

1-2-14-ratatouille.en: Ratatouille is a French dish of slowly cooked summer vegetables.
1-2-14-ratatouille.zh: 普羅旺斯雜燴是一道用夏季蔬菜慢慢燉煮的法國菜。

1-2-15-escargot.en: I tried escargot in Paris, and it tasted like garlic butter.
1-2-15-escargot.zh: 我在巴黎吃了法國蝸牛，吃起來都是蒜味奶油的味道。

1-2-16-pot-au-feu.en: On cold nights, a bowl of pot-au-feu warms you right up.
1-2-16-pot-au-feu.zh: 寒冷的夜晚，來一碗火上鍋，整個人都暖起來。

1-2-17-coq-au-vin.en: Coq au vin is chicken cooked slowly in red wine.
1-2-17-coq-au-vin.zh: 紅酒燉雞就是把雞肉放在紅酒裡慢慢燉煮。

1-2-18-foie-gras.en: The foie gras was so rich that I could only eat a little.
1-2-18-foie-gras.zh: 那份鵝肝太濃郁了，我只吃得下一點點。

1-2-19-beef-bourguignon.en: Beef bourguignon tastes even better the next day.
1-2-19-beef-bourguignon.zh: 紅酒燉牛肉隔天吃會更好吃。

1-2-20-philly-cheesesteak.en: A Philly cheesesteak is thin beef and melted cheese in a long roll.
1-2-20-philly-cheesesteak.zh: 費城牛肉起司三明治就是長麵包裡夾著薄牛肉片和融化的起司。

1-2-21-meat-loaf.en: Grandma's meat loaf is the best comfort food I know.
1-2-21-meat-loaf.zh: 奶奶做的肉卷是我心中最療癒的食物。

1-2-22-apple-pie.en: Would you like your apple pie warm, with vanilla ice cream?
1-2-22-apple-pie.zh: 您的蘋果派要加熱，再配香草冰淇淋嗎？

1-2-23-biscuits-and-gravy.en: In the South, biscuits and gravy is a popular breakfast.
1-2-23-biscuits-and-gravy.zh: 在美國南方，肉汁比司吉是很受歡迎的早餐。

1-2-24-buffalo-wings.en: These Buffalo wings are too spicy, so pass me the blue cheese dip.
1-2-24-buffalo-wings.zh: 這些水牛城辣雞翅太辣了，把藍紋起司醬遞給我。

1-2-25-doner-kebab.en: The doner kebab meat is cut right off the turning spit.
1-2-25-doner-kebab.zh: 土耳其旋轉烤肉是直接從轉動的烤肉架上切下來的。

1-2-26-kebab.en: He grilled a lamb kebab with onions and green peppers.
1-2-26-kebab.zh: 他烤了一串夾著洋蔥和青椒的羊肉串。

1-2-27-baklava.en: Baklava is very sweet, so one small piece is enough for me.
1-2-27-baklava.zh: 果仁蜜餅很甜，我吃一小塊就夠了。

1-2-28-dolma.en: Each dolma is rice and meat rolled up in a grape leaf.
1-2-28-dolma.zh: 每個蔬菜鑲肉都是用葡萄葉把米飯和肉捲起來。

1-3-01-bolognese-sauce.en: A good Bolognese sauce needs to cook for at least two hours.
1-3-01-bolognese-sauce.zh: 好的波隆納肉醬至少要煮兩個小時。

1-3-02-lasagna.en: The lasagna is so cheesy that it's hard to cut neatly.
1-3-02-lasagna.zh: 這份千層麵起司多到很難切得整齊。

1-3-03-lasagna-sheet.en: Put one lasagna sheet down, then add sauce and cheese on top.
1-3-03-lasagna-sheet.zh: 先鋪一片千層麵片，再在上面加醬和起司。

1-3-04-spaghetti.en: My kids always order spaghetti with meatballs.
1-3-04-spaghetti.zh: 我家小孩每次都點肉丸義大利麵。

1-3-05-farfalle.en: Farfalle looks like little bow ties, so kids love it.
1-3-05-farfalle.zh: 蝴蝶麵看起來像小領結，所以小朋友很愛。

1-3-06-pesto-sauce.en: Pesto sauce is made with basil, pine nuts, garlic, and olive oil.
1-3-06-pesto-sauce.zh: 青醬是用羅勒、松子、大蒜和橄欖油做的。

1-3-07-carbonara.en: Real carbonara uses eggs and cheese, not cream.
1-3-07-carbonara.zh: 正統的起司培根蛋麵用的是蛋和起司，不是鮮奶油。

1-3-08-pumpkin-sauce.en: This pumpkin sauce is sweet, creamy, and perfect for autumn.
1-3-08-pumpkin-sauce.zh: 這南瓜醬香甜滑順，最適合秋天了。

1-3-09-conchiglie.en: The little shells of conchiglie hold a lot of sauce.
1-3-09-conchiglie.zh: 貝殼麵小小的殼可以包住很多醬汁。

1-3-10-macaroni.en: Macaroni and cheese is a classic American side dish.
1-3-10-macaroni.zh: 起司通心粉是經典的美式配菜。

1-3-11-linguine.en: I'll try the linguine with clams and white wine sauce.
1-3-11-linguine.zh: 我想試試白酒蛤蜊細扁麵。

1-3-12-smoked-salmon.en: The smoked salmon pasta has a light cream sauce and dill.
1-3-12-smoked-salmon.zh: 煙燻鮭魚義大利麵配的是清爽的奶油醬和蒔蘿。

1-3-13-alfredo-sauce.en: Alfredo sauce is rich, so I can't eat a big plate of it.
1-3-13-alfredo-sauce.zh: 奶油白醬很濃郁，我沒辦法吃一大盤。

1-3-14-marinara.en: If you don't like cream, choose the marinara instead.
1-3-14-marinara.zh: 如果你不喜歡奶油醬，可以改選番茄紅醬。

1-3-15-ravioli.en: The ravioli are filled with spinach and ricotta cheese.
1-3-15-ravioli.zh: 這些義大利方餃裡包的是菠菜和瑞可塔起司。

1-3-16-penne.en: Penne is easy to cook and goes well with almost any sauce.
1-3-16-penne.zh: 斜管麵很好煮，幾乎配什麼醬都好吃。

1-3-17-creamy-mushroom-and-bacon.en: Is the creamy mushroom and bacon pasta very heavy?
1-3-17-creamy-mushroom-and-bacon.zh: 奶油蘑菇培根麵會很膩嗎？

1-3-18-basil.en: Add some fresh basil just before you serve the pasta.
1-3-18-basil.zh: 義大利麵上桌前再加一些新鮮羅勒。

1-3-19-cheese.en: Would you like some extra cheese on your pasta?
1-3-19-cheese.zh: 您的義大利麵要再加點起司嗎？

1-3-20-tomato.en: Cut the tomato into small pieces for the bruschetta topping.
1-3-20-tomato.zh: 把番茄切成小塊，鋪在普切塔上。

1-3-21-margherita-pizza.en: A margherita pizza has tomato, mozzarella, and basil, like the Italian flag.
1-3-21-margherita-pizza.zh: 瑪格麗塔披薩有番茄、莫札瑞拉起司和羅勒，就像義大利國旗的顏色。

1-3-22-supreme-pizza.en: The supreme pizza has almost every topping on the menu.
1-3-22-supreme-pizza.zh: 總匯披薩幾乎放了菜單上所有的配料。

1-3-23-hawaiian-pizza.en: Some people love Hawaiian pizza, but others hate pineapple on pizza.
1-3-23-hawaiian-pizza.zh: 有些人超愛夏威夷披薩，但也有人很討厭披薩上放鳳梨。

1-3-24-pepperoni-pizza.en: Let's get a large pepperoni pizza for movie night.
1-3-24-pepperoni-pizza.zh: 電影之夜我們來叫一個大的辣味香腸披薩吧。

1-3-25-veggie-pizza.en: The veggie pizza has mushrooms, peppers, olives, and onions.
1-3-25-veggie-pizza.zh: 蔬食披薩上有蘑菇、甜椒、橄欖和洋蔥。

1-3-26-seafood-pizza.en: This seafood pizza is topped with shrimp, squid, and clams.
1-3-26-seafood-pizza.zh: 這個海鮮披薩上面放了蝦、花枝和蛤蜊。

1-4-01-chafing-dish.en: Please close the lid of the chafing dish to keep the food warm.
1-4-01-chafing-dish.zh: 請把餐鍋的蓋子蓋上，食物才會保溫。

1-4-02-bread-basket.en: Could you bring us another bread basket, please?
1-4-02-bread-basket.zh: 可以再給我們一籃麵包嗎？

1-4-03-tongs.en: Use the tongs, not your fingers, to pick up the bread.
1-4-03-tongs.zh: 拿麵包要用夾子，不要用手。

1-4-04-salad-bar.en: I always start with a small plate from the salad bar.
1-4-04-salad-bar.zh: 我每次都先從沙拉吧拿一小盤開始吃。

1-4-05-sashimi.en: The sashimi at this buffet is fresh and cut nice and thick.
1-4-05-sashimi.zh: 這家吃到飽的生魚片很新鮮，切得也很厚。

1-4-06-tuna.en: The fatty tuna melts in your mouth.

1-4-07-salmon.en: Salmon is my favorite because it's rich and a little sweet.
1-4-07-salmon.zh: 鮭魚是我的最愛，因為它油脂豐富又帶點甜味。

1-4-08-mussel.en: If a mussel stays closed after cooking, don't eat it.
1-4-08-mussel.zh: 淡菜煮完如果還沒打開，就不要吃。

1-4-09-shrimp.en: I peeled so much shrimp that my fingers smelled like garlic.
1-4-09-shrimp.zh: 我剝了好多蝦子，手指都是蒜味。

1-4-10-salad-dressing.en: Do you want your salad dressing on the side?
1-4-10-salad-dressing.zh: 你的沙拉醬要另外放嗎？

1-4-11-thousand-island-dressing.en: Thousand island dressing is sweet, pink, and a little tangy.
1-4-11-thousand-island-dressing.zh: 千島醬是粉紅色的，甜甜的又帶點酸。

1-4-12-wafu-dressing.en: Japanese-style dressing is light and tastes of soy sauce and sesame.
1-4-12-wafu-dressing.zh: 和風醬很清爽，吃得到醬油和芝麻的味道。

1-4-13-caesar-dressing.en: Caesar dressing is made with garlic, lemon, and Parmesan cheese.
1-4-13-caesar-dressing.zh: 凱薩醬是用大蒜、檸檬和帕瑪森起司做的。

1-4-14-charcuterie-board.en: The charcuterie board had salami, ham, olives, and crackers.
1-4-14-charcuterie-board.zh: 熟食冷肉盤上有義大利臘腸、火腿、橄欖和餅乾。

1-4-15-assorted-cheese-platter.en: Try a bit of everything on the assorted cheese platter.
1-4-15-assorted-cheese-platter.zh: 綜合起司盤上的每一種都吃一點看看。

1-4-16-dim-sum.en: We had dim sum with my grandparents every Sunday morning.
1-4-16-dim-sum.zh: 以前每個星期天早上，我們都跟爺爺奶奶去吃港式點心。

1-4-17-fried-rice.en: Day-old rice works best for making fried rice.

1-4-18-fried-noodles.en: The fried noodles at the buffet were a little too oily.
1-4-18-fried-noodles.zh: 吃到飽的炒麵有點太油了。

1-4-19-chef.en: The chef came out to ask how we liked the meal.
1-4-19-chef.zh: 主廚出來問我們覺得餐點怎麼樣。

1-4-20-prime-rib.en: The prime rib is slow-roasted and served with its own juices.
1-4-20-prime-rib.zh: 這份牛肋排是慢烤的，上桌時會淋上它自己的肉汁。

1-4-21-carving-station.en: At the carving station, the cook slices the roast beef for you.
1-4-21-carving-station.zh: 在現切台，廚師會當場幫你切烤牛肉。

1-4-22-beverage-station.en: You can get coffee and juice at the beverage station.
1-4-22-beverage-station.zh: 咖啡和果汁可以到飲料台拿。

1-4-23-ice-cream-freezer.en: The kids ran straight to the ice cream freezer after dinner.
1-4-23-ice-cream-freezer.zh: 晚餐一吃完，孩子們就直奔冰淇淋櫃。

1-4-24-chocolate-fountain.en: Dip a strawberry into the chocolate fountain with a long stick.
1-4-24-chocolate-fountain.zh: 用長籤把草莓伸進巧克力噴泉裡沾一沾。

1-4-25-bread-and-dessert.en: The bread and dessert section is at the end of the buffet line.
1-4-25-bread-and-dessert.zh: 麵包與甜點區在自助餐檯的最後面。

1-4-26-doughnut.en: I can never say no to a warm glazed doughnut.
1-4-26-doughnut.zh: 熱騰騰的糖霜甜甜圈我永遠拒絕不了。

1-4-27-baguette.en: A fresh baguette is crispy outside and soft inside.
1-4-27-baguette.zh: 新鮮的長棍麵包外脆內軟。

1-4-28-multigrain-bread.en: I choose multigrain bread because it keeps me full longer.
1-4-28-multigrain-bread.zh: 我選雜糧麵包，因為比較有飽足感。

1-4-29-bagel.en: I'd like a toasted bagel with cream cheese, please.
1-4-29-bagel.zh: 我要一個烤過的貝果，抹奶油乳酪，謝謝。

1-4-30-strawberry-cake.en: We ordered a strawberry cake for my sister's birthday.
1-4-30-strawberry-cake.zh: 我們訂了一個草莓蛋糕幫妹妹慶生。

1-4-31-creme-brulee.en: Tap the top of the crème brûlée with your spoon to crack the sugar.
1-4-31-creme-brulee.zh: 用湯匙敲一敲焦糖烤布蕾的表面，把糖殼敲破。

1-4-32-panna-cotta.en: This panna cotta is smooth and served with berry sauce.
1-4-32-panna-cotta.zh: 這份奶酪口感滑順，還淋上了莓果醬。

1-5-01-sunflower-seed.en: Sprinkle a few sunflower seeds on your salad for some crunch.
1-5-01-sunflower-seed.zh: 在沙拉上撒一些葵花籽，吃起來更脆。

1-5-02-almond.en: This salad has toasted almond slices and goat cheese on top.
1-5-02-almond.zh: 這道沙拉上面有烤過的杏仁片和山羊起司。

1-5-03-butterhead.en: Butterhead lettuce has soft leaves that feel almost like butter.
1-5-03-butterhead.zh: 奶油萵苣的葉子很軟，口感幾乎像奶油一樣。

1-5-04-chestnut.en: Roasted chestnut adds a sweet, nutty taste to a winter salad.
1-5-04-chestnut.zh: 烤栗子能讓冬季沙拉多一份香甜的堅果味。

1-5-05-feta-cheese.en: Crumble some feta cheese over the tomatoes and cucumbers.
1-5-05-feta-cheese.zh: 把一些菲達起司捏碎，撒在番茄和小黃瓜上。

1-5-06-baby-carrot.en: Every baby carrot in this bag is washed and ready to eat.
1-5-06-baby-carrot.zh: 這袋裡的每根小紅蘿蔔都洗好了，可以直接吃。

1-5-07-sliced-radish.en: Sliced radish makes the salad look bright and pretty.
1-5-07-sliced-radish.zh: 小蘿蔔切片讓沙拉看起來色彩繽紛又漂亮。

1-5-08-cherry-tomato.en: Cut each cherry tomato in half before adding it to the bowl.
1-5-08-cherry-tomato.zh: 每顆小番茄都先切半，再放進碗裡。

1-5-09-pea.en: Not a single pea was left on my son's plate tonight.
1-5-09-pea.zh: 今晚我兒子盤子裡連一顆豌豆都沒剩。

1-5-10-peanut.en: Is there any peanut sauce in this salad? I'm allergic.
1-5-10-peanut.zh: 這道沙拉有加花生醬嗎？我會過敏。

1-5-11-cashew.en: Toast the cashew pieces in a dry pan until they turn golden.
1-5-11-cashew.zh: 把腰果放進乾鍋裡烘到變成金黃色。

1-5-12-pine-nut.en: One pine nut is tiny, but a handful adds lots of flavor.
1-5-12-pine-nut.zh: 一顆松子很小，但一把就能增添很多風味。

1-5-13-alfalfa-seed.en: You can grow sprouts at home from an alfalfa seed in a jar.
1-5-13-alfalfa-seed.zh: 用罐子裝苜蓿籽，就能在家裡種出苜蓿芽。

1-5-14-walnut.en: A walnut has a slightly bitter taste that goes well with apples.
1-5-14-walnut.zh: 核桃帶點微苦，跟蘋果很搭。

1-5-15-brazil-nut.en: A single Brazil nut is much bigger than an almond.
1-5-15-brazil-nut.zh: 一顆巴西堅果比杏仁果大很多。

1-5-16-hazelnut.en: Chocolate and hazelnut are a great match in desserts.
1-5-16-hazelnut.zh: 巧克力和榛果在甜點裡是絕配。

1-5-17-pecan.en: Candied pecan pieces make this salad taste like dessert.
1-5-17-pecan.zh: 裹糖的胡桃讓這道沙拉吃起來像甜點。

1-5-18-chickpea.en: Crispy roasted chickpea snacks are a healthy swap for croutons.
1-5-18-chickpea.zh: 烤得酥脆的鷹嘴豆是取代麵包丁的健康選擇。

1-5-19-pumpkin-seed.en: A pumpkin seed is green inside once you remove the shell.
1-5-19-pumpkin-seed.zh: 南瓜籽剝掉殼之後，裡面是綠色的。

1-5-20-italian.en: I'd like Italian on my salad, but just a little.
1-5-20-italian.zh: 我的沙拉要義式醬，但只要一點點。

1-5-21-ranch.en: Americans love dipping carrots and chicken wings in ranch.
1-5-21-ranch.zh: 美國人很愛拿紅蘿蔔和雞翅沾田園醬。

1-5-22-honey-mustard.en: Honey mustard is sweet and a little spicy at the same time.
1-5-22-honey-mustard.zh: 蜂蜜芥末醬吃起來又甜又帶點辣。

1-5-23-french.en: French is the orange, sweet dressing, right?
1-5-23-french.zh: 法式醬是那種橘色、甜甜的醬，對吧？

1-5-24-iceberg.en: Iceberg lettuce is very crunchy but doesn't have much flavor.
1-5-24-iceberg.zh: 美生菜很脆，但沒什麼味道。

1-5-25-radicchio.en: Radicchio is purple and a little bitter, so use just a few leaves.
1-5-25-radicchio.zh: 紫菊苣是紫色的，有點苦，放幾片就好。

1-5-26-leaf-lettuce.en: Leaf lettuce is soft and great for wrapping grilled meat.
1-5-26-leaf-lettuce.zh: 散葉萵苣很軟，很適合拿來包烤肉。

1-5-27-escarole.en: Escarole is a little bitter, but it tastes great in soup too.
1-5-27-escarole.zh: 闊葉苦苣有點苦，但煮湯也很好喝。

1-5-28-mizuna.en: Mizuna has thin, peppery leaves that are popular in Japanese salads.
1-5-28-mizuna.zh: 水菜的葉子細細的、帶點辛辣味，常用在日式沙拉裡。

1-5-29-tatsoi.en: Tatsoi has small, round leaves and a mild taste.
1-5-29-tatsoi.zh: 榻棵菜的葉子小小圓圓的，味道溫和。

1-5-30-chard.en: Rainbow chard has colorful stems in red, yellow, and pink.
1-5-30-chard.zh: 彩虹莙薘菜的莖有紅、黃、粉紅好幾種顏色。

1-5-31-belgian-endive.en: Use Belgian endive leaves like little boats for dips.
1-5-31-belgian-endive.zh: 比利時苦苣的葉子可以當小船，裝沾醬來吃。

1-5-32-romaine.en: A Caesar salad is usually made with crunchy romaine.
1-5-32-romaine.zh: 凱薩沙拉通常是用爽脆的蘿蔓做的。

1-5-33-kale.en: Massage the kale with a little olive oil to make it softer.
1-5-33-kale.zh: 用一點橄欖油搓揉羽衣甘藍，它會變得比較軟。

1-5-34-arugula.en: Arugula has a peppery taste that goes well with pizza.
1-5-34-arugula.zh: 芝麻葉帶點辛辣味，跟披薩很搭。

1-5-35-beet-greens.en: Don't throw away the beet greens; they're delicious when cooked.
1-5-35-beet-greens.zh: 甜菜葉別丟掉，煮熟後很好吃。

1-5-36-bell-pepper.en: A red bell pepper is sweeter than a green one.

1-5-37-cranberry.en: Dried cranberry pieces add a sweet and sour taste to salads.
1-5-37-cranberry.zh: 蔓越莓乾讓沙拉多了酸酸甜甜的味道。

1-5-38-blueberry.en: I put a blueberry on top of each little cake.
1-5-38-blueberry.zh: 我在每個小蛋糕上都放了一顆藍莓。

1-5-39-avocado.en: Is the avocado ripe? It should feel a little soft.
1-5-39-avocado.zh: 這顆酪梨熟了嗎？摸起來應該要有點軟。

1-6-01-caprese-salad.en: A caprese salad is just tomato, mozzarella, basil, and olive oil.
1-6-01-caprese-salad.zh: 卡布里沙拉其實就是番茄、莫札瑞拉起司、羅勒和橄欖油。

1-6-02-cobb-salad.en: My Cobb salad came with chicken, bacon, egg, and avocado.
1-6-02-cobb-salad.zh: 我的柯布沙拉裡有雞肉、培根、蛋和酪梨。

1-6-03-greek-salad.en: There's feta cheese and olives in the Greek salad.
1-6-03-greek-salad.zh: 希臘沙拉裡有菲達起司和橄欖。

1-6-04-poke-bowl.en: I build my own poke bowl with salmon, rice, and seaweed.
1-6-04-poke-bowl.zh: 我自己組了一碗夏威夷生魚飯，有鮭魚、白飯和海帶。

1-6-05-caesar-salad.en: Can I have the Caesar salad without croutons?
1-6-05-caesar-salad.zh: 我的凱薩沙拉可以不要麵包丁嗎？

1-6-06-fruit-salad.en: A cold fruit salad is the best dessert in summer.
1-6-06-fruit-salad.zh: 夏天最棒的甜點就是一碗冰涼的水果沙拉。

1-6-07-egg-salad.en: I made egg salad sandwiches for our picnic.
1-6-07-egg-salad.zh: 我做了蛋沙拉三明治帶去野餐。

1-6-08-potato-salad.en: Every family barbecue has a big bowl of potato salad.
1-6-08-potato-salad.zh: 每次家庭烤肉都會有一大碗馬鈴薯沙拉。

1-6-09-chefs-salad.en: A chef's salad has ham, turkey, cheese, and boiled eggs.
1-6-09-chefs-salad.zh: 主廚沙拉裡有火腿、火雞肉、起司和水煮蛋。

1-6-10-garden-salad.en: Would you like soup or a garden salad with your steak?
1-6-10-garden-salad.zh: 您的牛排要配湯還是田園沙拉？

1-6-11-green-papaya-salad.en: The green papaya salad is sour, sweet, and very spicy.
1-6-11-green-papaya-salad.zh: 青木瓜沙拉又酸又甜，還非常辣。

1-6-12-salade-nicoise.en: A salade Niçoise has tuna, eggs, green beans, and olives.
1-6-12-salade-nicoise.zh: 尼斯沙拉裡有鮪魚、蛋、四季豆和橄欖。

1-6-13-tabbouleh.en: Tabbouleh is full of parsley, mint, and lemon juice.
1-6-13-tabbouleh.zh: 塔布勒沙拉裡有滿滿的巴西里、薄荷和檸檬汁。

1-6-14-waldorf-salad.en: A Waldorf salad mixes apples, celery, walnuts, and mayonnaise.
1-6-14-waldorf-salad.zh: 華爾道夫沙拉是把蘋果、西洋芹、核桃和美乃滋拌在一起。

1-6-15-tuna-salad.en: I like tuna salad with a little sweet corn in it.
1-6-15-tuna-salad.zh: 我喜歡在鮪魚沙拉裡加一點玉米粒。

1-6-16-olivier.en: In Russia, people often eat Olivier salad on New Year's Eve.
1-6-16-olivier.zh: 在俄羅斯，大家常在跨年夜吃奧列夫沙拉。

1-6-17-shirazi-salad.en: Shirazi salad is chopped cucumber, tomato, and onion with lime juice.
1-6-17-shirazi-salad.zh: 設拉子沙拉是把小黃瓜、番茄和洋蔥切丁，再淋上萊姆汁。

1-6-18-pasta-salad.en: Pasta salad is easy to make the night before a party.
1-6-18-pasta-salad.zh: 義大利麵沙拉很好做，可以在派對前一晚先準備好。

1-6-19-fattoush.en: Fattoush is a salad with crispy pieces of fried pita bread.
1-6-19-fattoush.zh: 阿拉伯蔬菜沙拉裡有炸得酥脆的口袋餅碎片。

1-6-20-salade-lyonnaise.en: Salade Lyonnaise comes with bacon and a soft poached egg on top.
1-6-20-salade-lyonnaise.zh: 里昂沙拉上面放了培根和一顆軟嫩的水波蛋。

1-6-21-coleslaw.en: The fried chicken comes with a side of coleslaw.
1-6-21-coleslaw.zh: 炸雞附一份涼拌捲心菜絲。

1-7-01-host-hostess.en: The host will show you to your table in a minute.
1-7-01-host-hostess.zh: 接待員馬上就會帶您入座。

1-7-02-seat-a-customer.en: It's the hostess's job to seat a customer quickly and politely.
1-7-02-seat-a-customer.zh: 快速又有禮貌地帶客人入座，是接待員的工作。

1-7-03-serve-a-meal.en: Waiters should serve a meal from the guest's left side.
1-7-03-serve-a-meal.zh: 服務生應該從客人的左手邊上菜。

1-7-04-patron.en: Every patron gets a free drink on the restaurant's birthday.
1-7-04-patron.zh: 餐廳週年慶當天，每位顧客都可以獲得一杯免費飲料。

1-7-05-place-setting.en: Each place setting has two forks, a knife, and a spoon.
1-7-05-place-setting.zh: 每一副餐具都有兩支叉子、一把刀和一支湯匙。

1-7-06-set-a-table.en: Can you help me set a table for six people tonight?
1-7-06-set-a-table.zh: 你今晚可以幫我布置六個人的餐桌嗎？

1-7-07-take-an-order.en: The waiter came over to take an order from the next table.
1-7-07-take-an-order.zh: 服務生走過來幫隔壁桌點餐。

1-7-08-marinate-meat.en: I marinate meat in soy sauce, garlic, and honey overnight.
1-7-08-marinate-meat.zh: 我會用醬油、大蒜和蜂蜜把肉醃一整晚。

1-7-09-scramble-eggs.en: On weekends, I scramble eggs with a little milk and butter.
1-7-09-scramble-eggs.zh: 週末我會加一點牛奶和奶油來炒蛋。

1-7-10-peel-carrots.en: Can you peel carrots while I chop the onions?
1-7-10-peel-carrots.zh: 我切洋蔥的時候，你可以幫忙削紅蘿蔔皮嗎？

1-7-11-chop-spinach.en: Wash and chop spinach right before you cook it.
1-7-11-chop-spinach.zh: 菠菜要在下鍋前才洗、才切。

1-7-12-do-the-dishes.en: You cooked, so I'll do the dishes tonight.
1-7-12-do-the-dishes.zh: 你煮飯，那今晚我來洗碗。

1-7-13-stir-fry-vegetables.en: Stir-fry vegetables over high heat so they stay crunchy.
1-7-13-stir-fry-vegetables.zh: 炒菜要用大火，菜才會保持脆脆的。

1-7-14-blanch-broccoli.en: Blanch broccoli for one minute to keep it bright green.
1-7-14-blanch-broccoli.zh: 把青花菜燙一分鐘，就能保持翠綠。

1-7-15-dice.en: Dice the onion into small pieces for the sauce.
1-7-15-dice.zh: 把洋蔥切成小丁，用來做醬汁。

1-7-16-slice.en: Please slice the bread before you put it in the basket.
1-7-16-slice.zh: 麵包請先切片再放進籃子裡。

1-7-17-grate.en: Grate some fresh Parmesan over the pasta.
1-7-17-grate.zh: 在義大利麵上刨一些新鮮的帕瑪森起司。

1-7-18-season.en: Season the steak with salt and pepper before grilling.
1-7-18-season.zh: 烤之前先用鹽和胡椒幫牛排調味。

1-7-19-sift.en: Sift the flour so your cake will be light and fluffy.
1-7-19-sift.zh: 麵粉要過篩，蛋糕才會鬆軟輕盈。

1-7-20-grind.en: I like to grind fresh coffee beans every morning.
1-7-20-grind.zh: 我喜歡每天早上現磨咖啡豆。

1-7-21-stew.en: We stew beef with carrots and potatoes in winter.
1-7-21-stew.zh: 冬天我們會用紅蘿蔔和馬鈴薯燉牛肉。

1-7-22-deep-fry.en: It's safer to deep-fry chicken in a heavy, deep pot.
1-7-22-deep-fry.zh: 用又厚又深的鍋子炸雞比較安全。

1-7-23-fry.en: Fry the egg until the edges are golden and crispy.
1-7-23-fry.zh: 把蛋煎到邊緣金黃酥脆。

1-7-24-grill.en: Let's grill some corn and sausages in the backyard.
1-7-24-grill.zh: 我們在後院烤些玉米和香腸吧。

1-7-25-roast.en: Roast the potatoes in the oven for about forty minutes.
1-7-25-roast.zh: 把馬鈴薯放進烤箱烤大約四十分鐘。

1-7-26-toss.en: Toss the salad gently so every leaf gets some dressing.
1-7-26-toss.zh: 輕輕拌一拌沙拉，讓每片葉子都沾到醬。

d-01-diner.en: We had pancakes and coffee at a little diner by the highway.
d-01-diner.zh: 我們在公路旁一間小餐館吃了鬆餅、喝了咖啡。

d-02-reservation.en: I made a reservation for four people at seven o'clock.
d-02-reservation.zh: 我訂了七點、四個人的位子。

d-03-recommendation.en: Thanks for the recommendation; that pasta was amazing!
d-03-recommendation.zh: 謝謝你的推薦，那道義大利麵超好吃！

d-04-recommend.en: What do you recommend for someone who doesn't eat meat?
d-04-recommend.zh: 不吃肉的人，你會推薦什麼？

d-05-specialty.en: The house specialty is slow-cooked pork with apple sauce.
d-05-specialty.zh: 本店招牌菜是慢燉豬肉佐蘋果醬。

d-06-refill.en: Could I get a refill on my iced tea, please?
d-06-refill.zh: 我的冰紅茶可以續杯嗎？

1-8-01-pepper-shaker.en: Could you pass me the pepper shaker, please?
1-8-01-pepper-shaker.zh: 可以把胡椒罐遞給我嗎？

1-8-02-salt-shaker.en: Taste the soup before you reach for the salt shaker.
1-8-02-salt-shaker.zh: 先嚐嚐湯的味道，再去拿鹽罐。

1-8-03-bread-plate.en: Your bread plate is the small one on the left.
1-8-03-bread-plate.zh: 你的麵包盤是左邊那個小盤子。

1-8-04-butter-knife.en: Use the butter knife to spread butter on your roll.
1-8-04-butter-knife.zh: 用奶油刀把奶油抹在小餐包上。

1-8-05-dessert-spoon.en: The dessert spoon is placed above your plate.
1-8-05-dessert-spoon.zh: 甜點匙放在你的盤子上方。

1-8-06-champagne-flute.en: The tall, thin champagne flute keeps the bubbles longer.
1-8-06-champagne-flute.zh: 又高又細的香檳杯能讓氣泡維持得比較久。

1-8-07-wine-glass.en: Hold the wine glass by the stem, not the bowl.
1-8-07-wine-glass.zh: 拿葡萄酒杯要握杯腳，不要握杯身。

1-8-08-water-goblet.en: The waiter filled my water goblet before I even asked.
1-8-08-water-goblet.zh: 我還沒開口，服務生就幫我把水杯倒滿了。

1-8-09-dessert-fork.en: A dessert fork is smaller than a dinner fork.

1-8-10-soup-spoon.en: Move your soup spoon away from you when you eat soup.

1-8-11-teacup.en: My grandmother gave me a pretty flowered teacup.
1-8-11-teacup.zh: 奶奶送了我一個漂亮的花紋茶杯。

1-8-12-soup-bowl.en: Be careful, the soup bowl is very hot.

1-8-13-salad-fork.en: The salad fork is the shorter fork on the outside.
1-8-13-salad-fork.zh: 沙拉叉是放在最外側、比較短的那支叉子。

1-8-14-napkin.en: Put your napkin on your lap as soon as you sit down.
1-8-14-napkin.zh: 一坐下就把餐巾放在腿上。

1-8-15-dinner-fork.en: Use the dinner fork for your main course.

1-8-16-salad-plate.en: Please take a clean salad plate each time you go back.
1-8-16-salad-plate.zh: 每次回去拿菜時，請換一個乾淨的沙拉盤。

1-8-17-charger-plate.en: A service plate sits under your dishes but isn't for eating from.
1-8-17-charger-plate.zh: 服務盤墊在你的餐盤下面，但不是用來盛食物吃的。

1-8-18-dinner-knife.en: Cut your steak with the dinner knife, one bite at a time.
1-8-18-dinner-knife.zh: 用晚餐刀切牛排，一次切一口。

1-8-19-saucer.en: Put your cup back on the saucer between sips.
1-8-19-saucer.zh: 喝完一口之後，把杯子放回茶杯碟上。

1-8-20-teaspoon.en: Add one teaspoon of sugar to your tea.

1-8-21-teapot.en: Warm the teapot with hot water before you add the tea leaves.
1-8-21-teapot.zh: 放茶葉之前，先用熱水溫一下茶壺。

1-8-22-mug.en: I drink my coffee from a big mug every morning.
1-8-22-mug.zh: 我每天早上都用大馬克杯喝咖啡。

1-8-23-egg-cup.en: Put the soft-boiled egg in an egg cup and tap the top.
1-8-23-egg-cup.zh: 把半熟蛋放進蛋杯裡，敲敲頂端。

1-8-24-pitcher.en: Could we get a pitcher of water for the table?
1-8-24-pitcher.zh: 可以給我們這桌一壺水嗎？

1-8-25-serving-spoon.en: Please use the serving spoon, not your own spoon.
1-8-25-serving-spoon.zh: 請用公匙，不要用自己的湯匙。

1-8-26-salad-servers.en: Use the salad servers to put some salad on your plate.
1-8-26-salad-servers.zh: 用沙拉叉匙夾一些沙拉到你的盤子上。

1-8-27-platter.en: The waiter brought out a huge platter of grilled seafood.
1-8-27-platter.zh: 服務生端出一大淺盤的烤海鮮。

1-8-28-baking-dish.en: Pour the lasagna sauce into a large baking dish.
1-8-28-baking-dish.zh: 把千層麵的醬倒進一個大烤盤裡。

1-8-29-trivet.en: Put the hot pot on a trivet so it won't burn the table.
1-8-29-trivet.zh: 把熱鍋放在隔熱架上，才不會燙壞桌子。

1-8-30-coaster.en: Please put your glass on a coaster.
1-8-30-coaster.zh: 請把你的杯子放在杯墊上。

1-8-31-place-mat.en: Each child chose a colorful place mat for dinner.
1-8-31-place-mat.zh: 每個孩子都挑了一張彩色的餐具墊來吃晚餐。

1-8-32-dipping-dish.en: Pour a little soy sauce into the dipping dish.
1-8-32-dipping-dish.zh: 在沾醬碟裡倒一點醬油。

1-8-33-start.en: To show you're ready to start, keep your knife and fork beside the plate.
1-8-33-start.zh: 要表示準備開始用餐，就把刀叉放在盤子兩側。

1-8-34-next-dish.en: Cross your knife and fork on the plate when ready for the next dish.
1-8-34-next-dish.zh: 準備好吃下一道菜時，就把刀叉交叉放在盤子上。

1-8-35-excellent.en: Placing your knife and fork side by side across the plate means excellent.
1-8-35-excellent.zh: 把刀叉並排橫放在盤子上，表示這道菜很棒。

1-8-36-bad.en: A knife tip pushed between the fork's tines says the food is bad.
1-8-36-bad.zh: 把刀尖插進叉齒之間，是在告訴服務生這道菜不好吃。

1-8-37-break.en: Form an upside-down V with your knife and fork to take a break.
1-8-37-break.zh: 把刀叉擺成倒V字形，表示你只是暫停一下。

1-8-38-service-was-bad.en: Make a V with the tips of your knife and fork pointing at you if the service was bad.
1-8-38-service-was-bad.zh: 如果服務不好，就把刀叉擺成 V 字形，尖端朝向自己。

1-8-39-finished.en: Put your knife and fork together at four o'clock when you're finished.
1-8-39-finished.zh: 吃完時，把刀叉併攏放在四點鐘方向。

d-07-etiquette.en: Table etiquette is different in every country, so I always ask first.
d-07-etiquette.zh: 每個國家的餐桌禮儀都不一樣，所以我都會先問一下。

d-08-elegant.en: The restaurant was elegant, with candles and white tablecloths.
d-08-elegant.zh: 那間餐廳很雅緻，有蠟燭和白色桌巾。

d-09-embarrass.en: I don't want to embarrass myself by using the wrong fork.
d-09-embarrass.zh: 我不想因為拿錯叉子而讓自己出糗。

d-10-utensil.en: Start with the utensil on the outside and work your way in.
d-10-utensil.zh: 從最外側的餐具開始用，再一道一道往內拿。

d-11-placement.en: The placement of the glasses shows which one is for water.
d-11-placement.zh: 從杯子擺放的位置就能看出哪個是水杯。

d-12-invert.en: Some people invert their coffee cup to show they don't want any.
d-12-invert.zh: 有些人會把咖啡杯倒過來放，表示不需要咖啡。

d-13-parallel.en: Lay your knife and fork parallel on the plate when you're done.
d-13-parallel.zh: 吃完時，把刀叉平行放在盤子上。

lines.en: Good evening, welcome to Rosa's! Do you have a reservation?
lines.zh: 晚安，歡迎光臨 Rosa's！請問有訂位嗎？

lines.en: Yes, a table for two under Lara, at seven.
Right this way. Here are your menus.
Thanks. It's my first time here. What do you recommend?
lines.zh: 謝謝。我第一次來，你推薦什麼？

lines.en: Our specialty is the slow-roasted chicken with lemon and herbs.
lines.zh: 我們的招牌菜是檸檬香草慢烤雞。

lines.en: Sounds great. A friend also gave me a recommendation for the mushroom soup.
lines.zh: 聽起來很棒。我朋友也推薦我喝蘑菇濃湯。

lines.en: Good choice! Almost every diner who tries it comes back for more.
lines.zh: 好選擇！幾乎每位喝過的客人都會再回來點。

lines.en: Then I'll have both. Oh, could I get a refill of water, too?
lines.zh: 那我兩個都要。喔，還有水可以幫我再加滿嗎？

lines.en: Of course. I'll be right back with your water.
lines.zh: 當然，我馬上幫您把水送來。

lines.en: Amy, I'm going to an elegant restaurant next week, and I'm nervous.
lines.zh: Amy，我下週要去一間很高級的餐廳，好緊張。

lines.en: Don't worry. Good etiquette is mostly about staying calm and polite.
lines.zh: 別擔心，好的用餐禮儀重點就是保持冷靜、有禮貌。

lines.en: But there are so many forks! I don't want to embarrass myself.
lines.zh: 可是叉子好多支！我不想讓自己出糗。

lines.en: Easy. Use each utensil from the outside in, one for each course.
lines.zh: 很簡單，餐具從最外側往內用，一道菜用一副。

lines.en: And how do I know which bread plate and glass are mine?
lines.zh: 那我怎麼知道哪個麵包盤和杯子是我的？

lines.en: Just remember the placement: bread on your left, drinks on your right.
lines.zh: 記住擺放位置就好：麵包在左邊，飲料在右邊。

lines.en: What if I don't want any wine?
Just say "No, thank you." Don't invert your glass; it looks rude.
lines.zh: 說聲「不用了，謝謝」就好。別把杯子倒扣，那樣看起來很沒禮貌。

lines.en: Got it. And what do I do when I'm done eating?
lines.zh: 了解。那吃完的時候要怎麼做？

lines.en: Place your knife and fork parallel on your plate. That's the signal.
lines.zh: 把刀叉平行放在盤子上，這就是吃完的暗號。
